sources.title: Title boundary

sources.title: Tree preservation zone
sources.facts: 94,023 zones; 79 providers; collector/new data 2026-07-26; small-group/specification-development caveat.
sources.origin: official Planning Data dataset; mixed local-authority coverage
sources.guard: Partial provider coverage is not national completeness; zone geometry alone does not prove order validity/current status.

sources.title: Tree preservation zone type
sources.facts: 3 category entries: area, group, woodland; collector 2026-07-26.
sources.guard: Type code is vocabulary, not evidence that a particular tree is protected.

sources.title: Tree preservation order data specification
sources.facts: Specification updated 2026-04-10; requires order, zone and tree datasets; defines required fields and formats.
sources.guard: Specification requirements are not proof that any authority has complete/current published data.
